mapper.sql: select h.homework_id, h.submit_code, h.student_id, s.student_name, h.homework_title, h.practice_content, h.practice_requirement, h.submit_deadline, h.homework_status, h.teacher_remark, h.del_flag, h.create_by, h.create_time, h.update_by, h.update_time, h.remark from piano_homework h left join piano_student s on s.student_id = h.student_id and s.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select count(1) from piano_homework where del_flag = '0' and create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval weekday(curdate()) day) and create_time < date_add(date_sub(curdate(), interval weekday(curdate()) day), interval 7 day)
select count(1) from piano_homework where del_flag = '0' and submit_deadline is not null and submit_deadline < sysdate() and homework_status in ('0', '1', '2', '4')
where h.del_flag = '0' and h.homework_status = '0' order by h.submit_deadline is null, h.submit_deadline asc, h.homework_id desc limit 6
